en.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: those hypersensitive to this medicine; children under 12 years; male-pattern baldness; hair loss due to scarring; or androgenetic (hereditary) alopecia. Do not take if past the expiry date.

Consult a pharmacist before use if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding. If there is no improvement after 3–4 months of use, stop immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Consult a pharmacist when using with sulfonamide preparations.

If stomach pain, vomiting or other gastrointestinal discomfort, sweating, tachycardia, itching, hives, headache, dizziness, flushing, or hair growth on body areas other than the head occur, stop immediately and consult a pharmacist.
